marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 30 knots diminishing to west 15 to 20 early
Thursday morning and to west 10 to 15 early Thursday evening. Scattered showers early this evening changing to scattered
flurries and ending after midnight. Scattered flurries Thursday afternoon and
evening. Fog patches Thursday afternoon. Temperatures near zero. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 to 2 metres subsiding to 1 or less early
Thursday evening.<br/>

marine.title: Extended Forecast
marine.text:
Friday: Wind light increasing to southeast 20 knots
 late in the day.<br/>Saturday: Wind southeast 30 knots diminishing to
 southeast 20 late in the day.<br/>Sunday: Wind light.<br/>
